question: What specific capacity in mAh/g did the strained V2O5 films deliver?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%capacity%' OR text ILIKE '%mAh%' OR text ILIKE '%mAh/g%' OR text ILIKE '%discharge%' OR text ILIKE '%mA h%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%capacit%' OR text ILIKE '%mAh%' OR text ILIKE '%mA h%' OR text ILIKE '%mAh g%' ORDER BY page

SELECT 'ocr' AS src, figure_id AS id, text FROM figure_ocr WHERE text ILIKE '%capac%' OR text ILIKE '%mah%' OR text ILIKE '%specific%' OR text ILIKE '%mA%' UNION ALL SELECT 'fact', figure_id, statement FROM figure_facts WHERE statement ILIKE '%capac%' OR statement ILIKE '%mah%' OR statement ILIKE '%specific%' UNION ALL SELECT 'line', id, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%specific%' OR text ILIKE '%g−1%' OR text ILIKE '%g-1%' OR text ILIKE '%mA g%'
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (4,5,6) AND (text ILIKE '%strained%' OR text ILIKE '%galvano%' OR text ILIKE '%charge%') ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE (page=6 AND line_no>=120) OR (page=5 AND line_no>=34) OR (page=4 AND line_no BETWEEN 20 AND 36) ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, figure_id, statement, value, unit, printed_text FROM figure_facts WHERE figure_id IN ('p5.F4') OR statement ILIKE '%mA%' OR unit ILIKE '%mAh%'

SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%retention%' OR text ILIKE '%C-rate%' OR text ILIKE '%C/%' OR text ILIKE '%mA %' OR text ILIKE '%mA/%' OR text ILIKE '%g−1%' OR text ILIKE '%mAh%' OR text ILIKE '%capacity%' ORDER BY page, line_no

runs.text: The document does not report a specific capacity in mAh/g for the strained V2O5 films. The electrochemical results are given as cyclic voltammograms, peak-current scan-rate analysis, average equilibrium potential shifts, and diffusion coefficient ratios. The galvanostatic charge–discharge curves are said to be in the Supporting Information (Figures S12 and S13), which is not part of this document. The only mention of galvanostatic charge–discharge testing is the sentence on the strained-state electrochemistry, and no capacity value accompanies it.
